data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Medical isotope plant loss in South Africa
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve was GBP 4m, settled at GBP 1.7m, resulting in a release.
A recent reserve of GBP 1.4m was established for a possible material damage loss.

named_events.loss_description: A pipe burst resulting in an inundation of seawater into the reactor systems. The Syndicate has reserved the claim in line with estimates at a cost of Yen 686m. Because the loss is reserved in Yen, which has depreciated against sterling, the loss has reduced; although this reduction is matched by a loss on Yen cash held to hedge against the claim.
A loss at a medical isotope plant in South Africa. The reserve last year was some GBP 4m; although the claim was settled at less than this, at GBP 1.7m.
An additional loss was experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.
The Syndicate has also established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1176 reported a significant release of GBP 9.5 million in technical reserves for prior periods in 2014, representing a 24.1% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was partly driven by the settlement of a medical isotope plant loss in South Africa for GBP 1.7 million against a prior reserve of GBP 4 million, resulting in a GBP 2.3 million release. However, this was partially offset by a GBP 1.4 million strengthening for a new material damage loss in China. The overall release indicates favorable claims development across the portfolio for older underwriting years.
